name: 🎨 Draw the Other Half!
desc:
🎨 Can you finish the picture? 🎨

Sit at a table, get HALF of a picture — and draw the other half! The closer your drawing is to the original, the higher your score. Beat your opponent to win Cash and Wins! 🏆

✨ FEATURES ✨
🗳️ Vote for a theme every round: Animals, Emoji, Love, Football, Sport, Anime, Hard mode & more!
🎡 Spin the picture roulette — or pick your own picture
💀 Hard Mode: detailed pictures, DOUBLE cash
🪑 Collect 35+ chairs — from Common to Limited!
🎉 20+ Win Effects: lightning, meteors, black holes... play them on your opponent!
😈 Troll the whole server: Nuke, Blur, Paint Splash, Fart!
🧗 Art parkour — reach the top for +1 Win
🎁 Daily rewards, playtime gifts & group rewards
🏅 Leaderboards — become the best artist!

👍 Like & ⭐ Favorite the game for more updates!
🎨 Join the group "Draw . . . Draw" for a FREE exclusive chair!

llm.loop: sit at a table -> get half a picture -> draw the other half -> similarity score decides the round -> cash, wins, chairs and effects
llm.objectives: draw the closest match to the original to beat your opponent
llm.progression: cash, wins, 35+ chairs, win effects, leaderboards
llm.instructions: draw the other half, vote themes, spin the picture roulette, hard mode for double cash
unique: auto-graded mirror drawing against a reference image
llm.thumbnails: half-drawn smiley and lion with red 6.7% vs green 95% scores
llm.complexity_notes: canvas drawing and image similarity scoring, table matchmaking
